statutoryTitle: Currency and Bank Notes Act (Damaged Banknote Scheme)
promulgatingAgency: Bank of England — Damaged Banknotes Section
scope: Redemption of torn, soiled, washed, or burned Bank of England paper and polymer legal tender.

standardThreshold.conditions: As a general rule, the Bank of England pays full face value if more than half of a banknote is presented. If 50% or less remains, the claimant must satisfy the Bank that the remaining portion was completely destroyed.

polymerSubstrateHandling.shrinkage: Polymer banknotes subjected to direct thermal heat shrink without losing mass. The Debden laboratory calculates original area prior to thermal shrinkage using mass ratios.

rules.commercialBankExchange: High street retail banks (Barclays, HSBC, Lloyds, NatWest) accept damaged notes with clear >50% surface for direct account deposit.
